title: All Star Wineries of Kelowna Tour
includes: Alcoholic drinks, besides wine tasting (available to purchase) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age is 19 years old. Must have valid photo ID
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
policies: Please note tour start times are not guaranteed and are based on availability. When your tour is confirmed, we will let you know your pick up time from your accommodation.
This tour includes tastings at 5 wineries.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Visit Kelowna's best wineries all on one tour. You will get to view the beautiful scenery from each of these wineries and taste their fantastic wine. Experience the best Kelowna has to offer. This tour includes tastings in at least 4 of these listed wineries: Summerhill, Frind Estate, Mission Hill, Vibrant Vine, Sandhill and Quails Gate.
